title: Petanin Potentiated JNK Phosphorylation to Negatively Regulate the ERK/CREB/MITF Signaling Pathway for Anti-Melanogenesis in Zebrafish.
authors: Ouyang, Jian; Hu, Na; Wang, Honglun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究花青素petanin通过JNK/ERK/CREB/MITF通路抑制黑色素生成，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是酶活性与信号通路调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Petanin, an acylated anthocyanin from the Solanaceae family, shows potential in tyrosinase inhibitory activity and anti-melanogenic effects; however, its mechanism remains unclear. Therefore, to investigate the underlying mechanism of petanin's anti-melanogenic effects, the enzyme activity, protein expression and mRNA transcription of melanogenic and related signaling pathways in zebrafish using network pharmacology, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation were combined for analysis. The results showed that petanin could inhibit tyrosinase activity and melanogenesis, change the distribution and arrangement of melanocytes and the structure of melanosomes, reduce the activities of catalase (CAT) and peroxidase (POD) and enhance the activity of glutathione reductase (GR). It also up-regulated JNK phosphorylation, inhibited ERK/RSK phosphorylation and down-regulated CREB/MITF-related protein expression and mRNA transcription. These results were consistent with the predictions provided through network pharmacology and molecular docking. Thus, petanin could inhibit the activity of tyrosinase and the expression of tyrosinase by inhibiting and negatively regulating the tyrosinase-related signaling pathway ERK/CREB/MITF through p-JNK. In conclusion, petanin is a good tyrosinase inhibitor and anti-melanin natural compound with significant market prospects in melanogenesis-related diseases and skin whitening cosmetics.
abstract_zh: Petanin，一种来自茄科（Solanaceae）的酰化花青素，在酪氨酸酶抑制活性和抗黑色素生成作用方面显示出潜力；然而，其机制尚不清楚。因此，为探究petanin抗黑色素生成作用的潜在机制，结合网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，对斑马鱼中黑色素生成及相关信号通路的酶活性、蛋白表达和mRNA转录进行了分析。结果表明，petanin能抑制酪氨酸酶活性和黑色素生成，改变黑色素细胞的分布与排列及黑色素体的结构，降低过氧化氢酶（CAT）和过氧化物酶（POD）的活性，并增强谷胱甘肽还原酶（GR）的活性。它还上调了JNK磷酸化，抑制了ERK/RSK磷酸化，并下调了CREB/MITF相关蛋白表达和mRNA转录。这些结果与通过网络药理学和分子对接提供的预测一致。因此，petanin可通过p-JNK抑制并负调控酪氨酸酶相关信号通路ERK/CREB/MITF，从而抑制酪氨酸酶活性及其表达。总之，petanin是一种良好的酪氨酸酶抑制剂和抗黑色素天然化合物，在黑色素生成相关疾病和皮肤美白化妆品方面具有显著的市场前景。
